---
title: "Privacy"
---

*Last updated: November 4, 2026*

This website is free to read. It has no accounts, no advertising, and nothing for sale. This page explains, in plain words, what information is involved when you visit.

## What we count

We count visits to learn how many people read the site and which pages they open. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics for this. It does not use cookies, and it does not build a profile of you or follow you from site to site. We see totals only, such as pages viewed, the country, the type of device and browser, and which site sent you here.

## What we do not collect

We do not ask for your name, email address or any other personal details. We do not sell or share information about visitors, and we do not show ads.

## What stays on your device

The study tools on this site are saved only in your own browser. This covers your highlights, notes, bookmarks, text size and any pages saved for offline reading. This information is not sent to us. To remove it, clear this site's data in your browser settings.

## Other companies involved

- **Cloudflare** delivers this website to you. Like any web host, it handles technical details such as your internet address in order to send pages and keep the site secure. See Cloudflare's own privacy policy for how it handles this.
- **Google Fonts** supplies the typefaces used here, so your browser requests them from Google when a page loads. See Google's privacy policy for details.
- **Translation.** If you use your browser's translate feature, the text of the page is sent to your browser's translation provider (such as Google or Apple) under their rules, not ours.

## If you share a page

The Share button uses your own device's sharing options. We do not receive what you share or who you send it to.

## Changes

If we change how the site works in a way that affects this page, we will update it and change the date at the top.
